notes: «قال أبو الحسن بن سلمة حدثنا» opens the chain: his name is the first link
«قال سألت الشافعي»: the asker أبو اليمان is a link, the one asked الشافعي is the last link (he speaks the explanation); the Prophet's words are quoted, not a link
The bare «الشافعي» is written as he stands in the text; no fuller name is supplied
